reason: 99 euros is cheap next to what I pay my freelancer, but I'm paying her for results I can see, not for 'AI co-workers' I'd have to set up and babysit. At most I'd poke at the free plan, I wouldn't pay this month.
objection: I don't believe an AI 'Marketing Manager' produces work as good as my freelancer's without me spending my evenings checking and fixing it, and I have no idea what 100 credits actually gets me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run on a business like mine for a month on the free plan or a pilot, with real output I could put next to my freelancer's invoice.
